t: Waterfowl Hunting: The Ultimate Mixed Bag Morning
d: The Wingmen crew and family hit a river goose spot on a warm, windy December morning. With mild weather keeping the birds scarce, it turns into a slow-burn hunt, as widgeon, a mallard and a rare gadwall hen fall over the decoys. Along the way, they explain how to tell a mature widgeon hen from a juvenile by its wing feathers.

t: Would You Hunt with the 22 Creedmoor? Speed Test & Hornady Review
d: Can a .22-caliber rifle reach 1,500 yards? Todd Helms puts Hornady's 22 Creedmoor to the test with four loads: Precision Hunter, Match, V-Match and Superformance CX. He shoots groups and clocks velocities over the chronograph, and shares the Wyoming mule deer he took with the 80-grain ELD-X.

t: Grit Pays Off! DIY Elk Bow Hunt with Brian Barney
d: Twelve days into a tough September elk season, Brian Barney and buddy Dylan Ness pack a lightweight spike camp into public-land bowls and glass for a mature six-point. With an hour of light left, they ditch their packs, sprint to the next ridge and use the terrain to stalk into bow range. Then comes the hard part: breaking down the bull and getting the meat off the mountain on no sleep.

t: 3-Man Limit! River Duck Hunt with Wingmen
d: Crawl in the blind for a late-season waterfowl hunt on the river with the Wingmen crew. Todd Helms is joined by good friends Josh and Greg for some fellowship, and hopefully decoying a few ducks. Weather has been mild and the local birds are stale, but the guys manage to fill out a three-man limit on greenheads with some bonus geese in the mix.

Mike Eastman reviews Sig Sauer's Zulu6 HDX image-stabilizing binoculars. He shows how stabilization takes the shake out of glassing in the wind, why the 20-power model can replace a spotting scope in your pack, and how the upgraded HDX glass performs in low light.

t: Public Land Beast! Bow Hunting Big Bulls with Brian Barney
d: Join Eastmans' Elevated podcast host Brian Barney on this Beyond the Grid episode to bow hunt elk in the rugged backcountry in pursuit of arrowing a bugling bull! This DIY bow hunt is packed with navigating new valleys, winter weather, and Brian's signature spot-and-stalk tactics. From glassing ridges at first light to heart-pounding moments with screaming bulls, this is elk hunting in the raw.
Iowa Land Specialist Ben Harshyne chases an awesome buck on his Iowa farm with bow in hand. Followed up by Missouri Land Specialist Jeff Propst chasing a buck during the firearm season.

But this year was different. With all his gator tags filled and a little time to spare, Jacob hit the banks of the Yellow Stone River in Montana for an unforgettable hunt.
